en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban boulevard lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings on the left and a fenced garden or park on the right. A few pedestrians and early motor vehicles appear on the road. In the distance, a rocky hill with structures on top rises over the city. Text at the bottom in English and Greek identifies the scene as Amelie Boulevard in Athens. A modern watermark with a website URL is also visible.
